title: Small undecidable groups and fixed-size Adian–Rabin families
summary: Lean 4 proofs of the algebraic results in Small undecidable groups and unrecognizable 4-manifolds (arXiv:2609.10461v1): existence of a group with a three-generator, nine-relator presentation and unsolvable word problem; an effective family of four-generator, eleven-relator presentations with undecidable triviality; and an effective family of two-generator, ten-relator presentations with undecidable triviality. These are Theorems 1.1, 1.3, and 1.4 of the paper. The four-manifold consequences in the paper are outside the formalized scope.
